text_block_list.text:
The town is colored with illuminations, a 
Christmas overflowing with sparkle and 
excitement—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hey! Ready? Ready, setâ

text_block_list.name: Tap and Friends
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays!! Happy holidays!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Turkey, yeahhhh! I get the 
drumstick! And give me a mountain of 
mashed potatoes!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright, I'll cut it now. —Oh, 
it's got all sorts of stuff inside."

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Looks delish~! Here, pass this plate over 
to Tap.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks! Did everyone get some? Well then, 
let's eat!"

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
So good♡ Oh man, I can't stop. If I eat 
this much, I won't have room for cake~!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
HAHA! Didn't you always say you have a 
separate stomach for cake?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Trainer-san, where's the 
cake~?

text_block_list.name: Tap's Friends
text_block_list.text: Kyaaa~âª

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now, for the main event of the party! 
Let's do the gift exchange!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
K! Pass the gifts around while the music 
plays, and keep whatever you have when it 
stops~.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Here we go! Cue the music!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! This is so coooooool!! Who put this 
mug in here!?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, this is incredible! Is it 
psychedelic, or punk, or...? It's like an 
explosion of art!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Such cutting-edge style, it's 
amazing! Who is this artist?

What I prepared was a mug featuring my own 
illustration. Using a service that lets 
you make custom merch, I put a drawing of 
everyone spending time at this base on it.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text: "Huh, Trainer!? That's so unexpected~~!"

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text: Hey, could this possibly be... us?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you're right... These aren't horns, 
they're twintails. Oh, and this one 
dancing here is me!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! This gift's full of memories! 
Thanks, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, let's play a board game! I 
brought that one you said you were curious 
about!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that treasure hunting game, right! 
It's super hard, with a 100% clear rate of 
only 20%? Heheh, now I'm fired up!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Tap's got that look in her eyes. Guess 
we're pulling an all-nighter till we clear 
this, huh~?

The Christmas party had been a massive 
success. However, the festivities were 
soon drawing to an endâ

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we'll walk these kids home. Tap, 
don't you dare slack on cleaning up, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, leave it to me! With the two of us, 
Trainer, it'll be done in a flash!
choice_data_list:
Because I'm going to have Tap work hard 
too

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's Trainer for you! See ya, 
Tap! I'm super excited for the Arima 
Kinen, okay~? ♪

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Okay, I'll do my best! I'm gonna show our 
new crewmates what I'm made of!"

We finished cleaning up and set off for 
home. Walking in silence down the 
illuminated street, the city's hustle and 
bustle felt somehow distant.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ......The end never comes...

A quiet mutter. I could faintly make out 
the words, "There is no end."

Chanted almost like an incantation, the 
words seemed to carry a heartfelt, 
desperate wish.

—She just wants to party forever with her 
friends. That is Tap Dance City's wish. 
She never wants it to end.
choice_data_list:
Shall we have an after-party, just the two 
of us?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What? Right now...? Huh? Is my Trainer 
actually encouraging me to break curfew?
choice_data_list:
Looks like they haven't had enough fun 
making noise yet.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! Yeah, that's right! As long as you 
and I are here, the party never ends!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I was actually just remembering 
something from the past. I always hated 
the walk home after a party at a friend's 
house, you see."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Just moments ago, we were making so much 
noise under the bright lights. And now I 
have to walk down this dim path all by 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It was a path back to reality. Almost like 
an exit from a dream. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"The party doesn't have to end. If we head 
to the base, our friends are there!"
choice_data_list: Yeah. That's what this base is for.
Yeah. That's what this base is for.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to you, Navigator.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't want to start any dishonorable 
rumors about you. As reluctant as I am to 
leave, let us return to the dorms for 
today.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —No worries, the party continues tomorrow!

Saying so with a broad smile, Tap Dance 
City took my hand and set off with a 
light, rhythmic stride. —Just like a tap 
dance.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm not alone anymore. I have a place to 
belong.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Then the party keeps on going! To the 
Arima Kinen, and beyond!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The day we tire of dancing and return to 
reality will never come again. Not as long 
as I have you, myself, and our friends!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Trainer! —Were there any falsehoods 
in what you just said?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: After-party time!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So with that, let's stock up on supplies 
and head back. What should we do? Board 
games? Watch a movie?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you said it! Then you'd better 
keep me company all the way to the end!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You're right, let's start with a toast! A 
cup to pledge our bond, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: In that mug you gave me!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Let us make a vow.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"We'll be together forever! A party time 
that never ends!"

Tap Dance City said with a beam spreading 
across her face. Her eyes shone like 
stars, gazing toward an endless dream.
